manifest_extDescription.message: Pick elements on development web pages, assemble DOM structure, matched CSS (file:line), and React/Vue source locations into context, then inject into the pi-web-ui conversation input with one click. Click the icon on a pi-web-ui page to bind the service address. The page bridge lets two paired pages read and write each other.

manifest_actionTitle.message: Pick web elements (add to pi-web-ui conversation)

options_hint.message: Press the extension icon on a development page (or $1) to start picking. The selected element will be assembled into context and injected into the pi-web-ui input box for you to add a description and send.

options_tokenPlaceholder.message: Leave empty if auth is not enabled

options_serverHint.message:
Only localhost / 127.0.0.1 permissions are pre-configured. After switching to a LAN IP, domain name, or https address (this is what remote deployments use): click "Authorize this address" first.
Easier way: click the extension icon directly on the pi-web-ui page — the extension will recognize that page and ask "Do you want to set it as the service address?" No need to type the address or port.
Delivery injects content into the pi-web-ui page open in the browser, so a page at this address must be open (can be in another tab/window, doesn't need to be current); if the page is closed, it degrades to "copy Markdown to clipboard".

options_bindBodyGranted.message: This address is already authorized. Click the button below to bind (content picked from other pages will be injected here).

options_bindBodyNotGranted.message: The browser requires one click on this page to authorize $1; click the button below to authorize and bind.

options_aiControlSection.message: AI Page Control (let the model read/write web pages)

options_aiControlHint.message:
After authorization, the model can use the browser_page tool to control that page in conversations: read (read text / query elements), click, type, scroll, goto, wait, and eval (execute arbitrary JS) when the toggle is on.
The other end is always the pi-web-ui page itself: the model's actions are sent to the extension from that pi-web-ui page in the browser, so that tab must be open (same trade-off as pick delivery); here you only need to authorize the page being controlled.
Only authorize pages you trust: after authorization, the model can click, type, and read its content. You can revoke at any time.

options_aiControlToggleDesc.message: When off, all page actions from the model are rejected immediately

options_allowEvalToggle.message: Allow arbitrary JS execution (eval, off by default)

options_allowEvalToggleDesc.message: Turning this on hands the page to model-written scripts: can modify data, submit forms, send requests

options_allowShotToggleDesc.message:
The model can see what the page looks like.
Turning this on will request "Read your data on all websites": the browser's screenshot API only recognizes this permission (or temporary authorization when you click the icon), regular authorization is not enough.
Also, screenshots can only capture the "currently active tab", so the extension will switch the target page to the foreground first, then switch back immediately after capturing (focus will jump briefly).
If you don't want to grant this permission, keep it off — the model can still read DOM text via read, it just can't "see" the page.

options_aiHint.message: No need to type addresses: click the extension icon once on the target page and it will appear in the candidates; or click "Let AI control this page..." on the development page's pick bar to auto-fill this page.

options_bridgeSection.message: Page Bridge (let two pages read/write each other)

options_bridgeHint.message:
After pairing, scripts in these two pages can call each other: the peer registers capabilities with window.__piBridge.on("readOrders", () =…), and this side gets results with await window.__piBridge.call({ op: "readOrders" }). Cross-origin, cross-tab, cross-window all work — only the extension in the browser can do this.
Bridge is off by default: only listed pairs below can communicate, and host permissions for both ends are authorized here.
On paired pages, any script (including third-party ad/analytics scripts) can access window.__piBridge, so only enable the bridge for pages you trust.

options_bridgeHint2.message:
No need to type addresses: click the extension icon once on each of the two pages you want to pair, and they will appear in the candidate dropdown of the two input fields above (one click fills it in); click "Pair with another page..." on the development page's pick bar to auto-fill this page.
Example: read production backend data from a dev page (on("orders", …) on the backend page), or let page A control page B (on("highlight", ({id}) => document.querySelector(`#${id}`)?.scrollIntoView())).
When the peer page is not open or hasn't registered that op, you'll get an error explaining why, instead of "no response".

options_sendHint.message: Each item is a category of information: checked means collect and send; unchecked means not collected at all (saves context and time). If there's too much info, pick a preset first, then adjust as needed.

options_screenshotsToggleDesc.message: Sent as attachments into the conversation (for text-only models, see the vision bridge)

options_copyToClipboardToggleDesc.message: Fallback when injection fails, recommended to keep on

options_focusTargetToggle.message: Switch to pi-web-ui tab after injection

options_focusTargetToggleDesc.message: When off, stay on the current page to continue viewing

options_pairEmpty.message: No pairs yet. Bridge is off by default — only pairs listed here can call each other.

options_aiEmpty.message: No pages authorized yet — the model currently has no pages to control.

status_serverOnlineNoTabs.message: Service online (cwd: $cwd$), but no page open in browser — delivery requires it to be open

status_connectionFailed.message: Cannot connect to service: $error$ (correct address? certificate trusted?)

status_shotDisabled.message: Screenshots disabled: model can only read DOM text via read

status_shotNeedPermission.message: Screenshots need "Read your data on all websites" permission: browser didn't grant it, kept off

status_shotEnabled.message: Screenshots allowed (target tab will be switched to foreground during capture, then switched back immediately)

status_bindAlreadyCurrentBody.message: No changes needed. To change the address, just edit the input above (auto-saved on change).

status_bindBound.message: Bound $base$ — content picked from other pages will be injected here

status_pairNotGranted.message: Not authorized $patterns$ — without authorization, the bridge can't be installed on the peer page and calls can't execute

status_pairAddedWithInstall.message: Paired $a$ ↔ $b$; $count$ open page(s) have the bridge installed

status_pairAddedAuto.message: Paired $a$ ↔ $b$ (bridge auto-installs when peer page opens)

status_pairEnabledWithInstall.message: Enabled; $count$ open page(s) have the bridge installed

status_pairEnabledAuto.message: Enabled (bridge auto-installs when peer page opens)

status_pairDisabled.message: Disabled: bridge on that pair of pages has been removed

status_pairDeletedWithUninstall.message: Deleted; $count$ page(s) had the bridge removed

status_pairDeepLinkFilled.message: Filled in this page $origin$ — select the other endpoint below (both pages must have been clicked once to appear in candidates)

status_aiInvalidAddress.message: Invalid address: must be an http/https origin, e.g. http://localhost:5173

status_aiNotGranted.message: Not authorized $pattern$ — without authorization, the control bridge can't be installed on that page

status_aiDeepLinkFilled.message: Filled in $origin$ — click "Authorize this page" and it becomes a page the model can control

deliver_noPermission.message: Not authorized $pattern$ — go to the extension options page and click "Authorize this address"$suffix$

deliver_injected.message: Added to pi-web-ui input ($n$ element(s)), add description and send

deliver_noHost.message: This pi-web-ui page doesn't support input injection (version too old), please update pi-web-ui and refresh the page

deliver_notReady.message: pi-web-ui input not ready yet, refresh the page and try again

bridge_noHttpOrigin.message: Page bridge can only be initiated from http/https pages (or the address is not authorized, can't read tab URL)

bridge_noPermission.message: Not authorized $pattern$ — go to the extension options page "Page Bridge" and click to authorize

bridge_peerNotOpen.message: Peer page ($peer$) not open — open it in a tab first

bridge_emptyResult.message: Extension returned empty result (service worker may have been recycled) — try again

bridge_resultNotClonable.message: Peer result cannot be transferred back: $error$

ai_statusDisabled.message: "AI Page Control" is turned off in extension settings — go to the options page and turn it on

ai_evalDisabled.message: "Execute arbitrary JS on page" is off by default — go to extension options "AI Page Control" to turn it on before using eval

ai_shotDisabled.message: "Allow screenshots" is turned off in extension settings — go to the options page to turn it on (when off, the model can only read DOM via read)

ai_noPermission.message: Not authorized $pattern$ — go to extension options "AI Page Control" to authorize this address

ai_pageNotOpen.message: Page ($peer$) not open — open it in a tab first

ai_shotPermissionNeeded.message: Screenshots need additional permission (read all website data): go to extension options "AI Page Control" and turn on "Allow screenshots" and authorize; if you don't want to grant this permission, keep it off (model can only read DOM via read)

ai_elementNotInViewport.message: Element is barely in the viewport, capture would be fragmented: $selector$

ai_screenshotFailedEmpty.message: Screenshot failed (page has no capturable content)

bindview_same_title.message: This page is the bound pi-web-ui

bindview_same_detail.message: $base$ — content picked from other pages will be injected here. Want to pick elements on this page?

bindview_notSame_detail.message: Change the pick service address from $bound$ to $base$? After that, picked content will be injected into this page.

bind_needAuth.message: One authorization needed ($pattern$): the browser requires this action to be clicked on the extension's own page

bind_bound.message: Bound $base$ — content picked from other pages will be injected here

bindbar_bindFailedNoResponse.message: Bind failed: background not responding, refresh the page and try again

picker_notePlaceholder.message: Overall note (optional): e.g. "these three spacings are inconsistent"

picker_alreadyInList.message: This element is already in the list

picker_resnapshotFailed.message: $count$ element(s) failed to re-capture with new settings (original content preserved)

picker_syncFailed.message: Not synced to extension settings (this selection only takes effect on this page)

picker_grantHereSuccess.message: This page pre-filled in settings — click "Authorize this page" to take effect

picker_grantHereFailed.message: Cannot open settings: please manually go to the extension options page to authorize

picker_pairHereSuccess.message: This page pre-filled in settings — select the other endpoint (the other page must also have been clicked once)

picker_pairHereFailed.message: Cannot open settings: please manually go to the extension options page to add a pair

picker_pairThisPageHint.message: Use this page as an endpoint, go to settings to select another page (both pages must have been clicked once)

grant_checking_hint.message: Asking extension background: has this page been authorized for model control

grant_null_hint.message: Extension background not responding (it may have been recycled) — you can still click, authorization is completed in the extension settings page

grant_notHttp_hint.message: The model can only control regular web pages (http/https) — browser internal pages, extension pages, and local files cannot be controlled

grant_unauthorized_hint.message: Let the model read/write $origin$ in conversations (can be revoked anytime in extension settings) — authorization requires a click on the extension's own page

grant_authorizedSwitchOff_hint.message: $name$ is authorized, but the "Allow AI page control" master switch in extension settings is off — turn it on for the model to act

grant_authorizedOn_status.message: Authorized · model can control this page

grant_authorizedOn_hint.message: $name$ is authorized: let the model control this page in a conversation (tool browser_page); revoke authorization in extension settings

section_selector_hint.message: Selector + tag name + dimensions (almost always needed when changing code)

section_locator_hint.message: Fallback positioning when selector is not unique / fails

section_source_hint.message: React/Vue file:line + component call chain — the key to "get it right the first time"

section_text_hint.message: Text inside the element (truncated if too long)

section_rules_hint.message: Which rule matched it, from which file and line

section_styles_hint.message: Only reports items different from default/inherited values (usually 3-5 lines)

section_skeleton_hint.message: Structure (child nodes collapsed to …), much more compact than full outerHTML

preset_lean_hint.message: Only locator + source location + short text: about 3-5 lines per element

preset_standard_hint.message: Plus matched CSS, computed style differences, and HTML skeleton

preset_full_hint.message: Everything, captured in greater depth (deeper selectors/skeletons, longer text)

preset_source_hint.message: Selector + source location (React/Vue file:line), no styles

preset_styles_hint.message: Selector + matched CSS + computed style differences (spacing/color/layout issues)

preset_text_hint.message: Selector + text + HTML skeleton, no source or styles
